titre: How to Build Monthly Recurring Income with the Tiquiz Affiliate Program
description: The Tiquiz affiliate program builds you monthly recurring income: 40% lifetime commission to start, rising to 70%, paid between the 10th and the 13th of every month.

blocs.html:
TL;DR:

The Tiquiz affiliate program builds you a monthly recurring income that lands between the 10th and the 13th of every month, as long as your referrals stay subscribed. You earn 40% lifetime commission at the minimum on every Tiquiz subscription generated through your link, and that rate climbs to 70% with the number of referrals who pay.

Real numbers: 1 monthly subscriber at €17/mo = €5.67/mo for life. 30 active referrals = €170/mo. 50 referrals on the annual plan = €2,833.33/yr.

One account, two products: the same link pays you 70% on the Atelier du Quiz, the €47 training, so €27.42 per sale. And your Tiquiz rate climbs by steps, from 40% up to 70%, with the number of referrals who pay.


Payouts via PayPal or bank transfer, from €20 and 30 days after your referral pays. Below that, the money stays yours and rolls into the next payout. No invoice to write (we issue it for you) and no signup conditions. You run everything from a dedicated Tiquiz affiliate dashboard: tracked links, image generator, editable post and email libraries, real-time commission tracking. Every referral stays tied to you for life.


Free signup: tiquiz.fr/affiliation.


Here's exactly how it works, how much you can build based on your audience type, and why this income is more solid than other programs on the market.

When you're a solopreneur, your cash flow tracks your sales curve. Good month, you breathe. Slow month, you're holding your breath. Then you're back hunting for whatever fills next month.

Alongside that volatile income, you can build a recurring monthly stream that lands no matter what. A line of income that adds to your baseline revenue, no dependence on this month's sales, no weekly prospecting required.

The Tiquiz affiliate program is one way to build that income. You earn 40% lifetime recurring commission at the minimum on every Tiquiz subscription you generate, and that rate climbs to 70% with the number of referrals who pay. Your commissions get paid out between the 10th and the 13th of every month. As long as your referral stays subscribed (and most stay at least 6 months), you keep getting paid.

And there's a scale effect very few programs offer: your rate itself climbs. It starts at 40%, moves to 45% on your first paying referral, and keeps going up to 70%, without lifting a finger.


Here's how it works in detail, how much you can earn based on the effort you want to put in, and how to set up your affiliate account in 2 minutes.

blocs.texte: 1. How the Tiquiz affiliate program builds automatic monthly income

blocs.html:
The mechanic is deliberately simple. Five steps, and your income starts.

Step 1. You sign up for free at tiquiz.fr/affiliation. You get your unique affiliate ID (a Systeme.io code starting with "sa").



Step 2. You share your tracked link: tiquiz.fr/?ref=YOUR_CODE. You can promote any Tiquiz page by adding your ID as a URL parameter.



Step 3. Anyone who clicks your link and then subscribes to a paid Tiquiz plan (monthly or annual) is tied to you for life. Whether they buy in 7 days or 18 months after the click, the commission is yours.



Step 4. You earn a commission on every payment your referral makes, 40% at the minimum. Not just the first month: on every renewal, every billing cycle, every month for years. That's what turns your commission into a recurring income stream.



Step 5. Your income is paid out between the 10th and the 13th of every month via PayPal or bank transfer. A commission becomes payable 30 days after your referral pays, and the transfer goes out from €20 onwards. No invoice to send, no follow-up needed: we write the invoice for you. You set up your payment method once and it lands every month.



What makes this a recurring income (and not a one-shot commission): the commission is recurring for life. As long as your referral stays subscribed, you keep getting paid. A referral who stays 3 years = 36 months of income on your account. A referral who stays 5 years = 60 months of income. That's the snowball.

blocs.texte: 2. How much you can build (real numbers)

blocs.html: This is the first question that comes up. Here are the exact numbers so you know where you stand.

2.2. Your income on the Yearly plan
2.3. Why monthly pays more over time

blocs.html:
Over 3 cumulative years, one monthly referral at €17 brings you €204 in total income. One annual referral at €170 brings you €170. The monthly plan wins over time for one simple reason: your referral pays more across the year, €17 twelve times is €204, against €170 in one go.


In practice, monthly referrals also have better retention because €17 a month with no commitment is psychologically easier to keep than €170 paid upfront. Most monthly referrals stay subscribed for at least 6 months.

The Tiquiz affiliate page includes an interactive simulator. You pick the number of referrals per plan type (Free, Monthly, Annual) and the projection window (1 month, 6 months, 1 year). The simulator calculates your projected income in real time.

blocs.texte: 3. Why 40% lifetime is an income, not a tip

blocs.html: 40% lifetime recurring, rising to 70%, is rare in the SaaS affiliate market. Here's exactly why that's what makes your income solid.

blocs.texte: 3.1. The problem with 20% programs

blocs.html:
At 20% on a €17/mo subscription, you earn €2.83 per referral per month. For a solopreneur, that doesn't build usable income. With 50 referrals, you cap out at €141.67 a month. Not enough to cover a slow month.


That's why most 20% SaaS affiliate programs don't build any real income for their affiliates. Just a token side payment.

blocs.texte: 3.2. The problem with one-shot programs (no recurring)

blocs.html: A lot of affiliate programs pay a single commission on the first month, then nothing. You collect once, and you have to keep recruiting new referrals to maintain your income. That's not recurring income, that's a treadmill.
Tiquiz works the opposite way: you earn every month your referral gets billed. Last year's referrals keep paying you this year. This year's referrals stack on top. The snowball is mathematical.

blocs.texte: 3.3. Why it starts at 40%

blocs.html: Because a rate has to pay for itself. There's hosting, AI costs, customer support, product development. A program that starts too high makes it back somewhere else, usually on the quality of the tool, and your income is what suffers when your referrals leave.
40% is where it starts: high enough that your income is worth chasing from day one, and it climbs as you bring people in, because at that point there is something to pay it with.

The 3 traits that make Tiquiz a solid recurring income

  1. Recurring: you get paid every month, not just once

  2. Lifetime: as long as your referral stays subscribed, your income keeps coming

  3. Automatic: paid between the 10th and the 13th of every month, with zero action from you

All three together, that's what defines a real recurring income. Drop one of them, and it's not recurring income anymore.

blocs.texte: 4. The same link pays you on the Atelier du Quiz

blocs.html:
You have one affiliate account, not two. The same link pays you on the Atelier du Quiz, the 7 day training at €47, at 70% commission, so €27.42 per sale, paid once.

A referral who takes the training and then subscribes to Tiquiz pays you on both. And your Tiquiz rate itself climbs by steps, from 40% up to 70%, with the number of referrals who pay.

blocs.texte: 4.1. What about the tools that come later

blocs.html:
Your referrals are tied to you for life, and that attribution belongs to the register, not to one product. Whatever ships later is covered by the same account.

I am not announcing a date, a price or a rate for anything that is not on sale yet. When it is, you will read it here with the numbers attached.

blocs.texte: 5. Who this Tiquiz affiliate income is really for

blocs.html: Tiquiz affiliate fits 4 main profiles. See if you recognize yourself.

blocs.texte: 5.1. Tiquiz users who talk about it naturally

blocs.html: You use Tiquiz for your own business. You mention it to your audience, your clients, your fellow solopreneurs. You don't have to "sell", you just share what's working for you.

With a 1,000-subscriber newsletter and a 1% conversion rate on your affiliate link (10 monthly referrals), you build €56.67/mo in income. Over a year, that's €680. Just for slipping your link into 2 or 3 emails to your list.

blocs.texte: 5.2. Systeme.io content creators (YouTube, blog, podcast, Instagram)

blocs.html:
You already make content on Systeme.io and the English-speaking solopreneur space. You're hunting for complementary tools to recommend. Tiquiz fits naturally into what you already do.


With a 5,000-subscriber YouTube channel targeting Systeme.io users, aiming for 30 to 50 active referrals over a year is realistic. That's €170 to €283.33/mo in income. No sponsored content, no extra marketing push.

blocs.texte: 5.3. Freelancers and agencies who resell Tiquiz

blocs.html:
You manage client projects (marketing, copywriting, Systeme.io funnels). You can integrate Tiquiz into your service and earn lifetime income on every client who pays for a subscription.


The classic example: you set up a Tiquiz quiz for a client as part of a project. Your client signs up for an annual plan at €170. You earn €56.67 in immediate commission. And as long as they stay subscribed in the years that follow, that income lands every year on autopilot, without follow-up.

blocs.texte: 5.4. Systeme.io affiliates who want a second income stream

blocs.html: You already do Systeme.io affiliate. You want a complementary income stream that adds on, without changing your target audience. Tiquiz is built for Systeme.io users (native integration), so you're hitting the exact same prospect base. You stack two income streams on the same audience.

blocs.texte: 6. Your kit to launch your affiliate income

blocs.html:
On signup, you step into a dedicated Tiquiz affiliate dashboard, not just a raw Systeme.io account. Everything's centralized so you can publish your first piece of content without creating any material from scratch.



Your tracked links all in one place, ready to copy. You can generate a link to any Tiquiz page (home, pricing, demo, Popquiz, affiliate page) in one click, with your ID injected automatically.



An image generator to back up your posts. You pick from a Tiquiz-branded library, or you generate a custom visual with your own headline. Ready-to-go formats for Instagram, LinkedIn, X, stories, and Pinterest.



An editable post library for LinkedIn, Instagram, X, and Threads. You edit the copy directly inside the dashboard, copy it, paste it. No more starting from a blank page every time.



An editable email library: intro sequence, demo, testimonial, follow-up. You adjust the tone to your list, paste in your tracked link, schedule from your own sending tool.



Real-time commission tracking: pending, validated, already paid out, comparison with last month. Tracking and payouts run through Systeme.io under the hood (lifetime attribution via cookie, automatic transfers between the 10th and 13th of every month), but you don't leave the Tiquiz dashboard to check your activity.



Coming soon to the dashboard: targeted advice based on your audience type (content creator, freelancer, infopreneur, coach), promotion strategies per channel (newsletter, YouTube, organic LinkedIn, Instagram), and content ideas to riff on every time Tiquiz ships a new feature.



The point is simple: you're never staring at a blank page. You open the dashboard, you grab what you need, you publish.

blocs.texte: 7. How to create your affiliate account in 2 minutes

blocs.html:
Signup is free, open to everyone worldwide, with no conditions. The income builds over time. What takes 2 minutes is setting up the account.



  1. Head to tiquiz.fr/affiliation

  2. Click "Get my affiliate link"

  3. Fill in the form: name, last name, email, payment method (PayPal or bank transfer)

  4. Get your affiliate ID by email (starts with "sa")

  5. Log in to your Tiquiz affiliate dashboard

  6. Explore your kit and ship your first piece of content



You pay nothing to become a Tiquiz affiliate. No subscription, no entry fee, no trial period to validate.

blocs.texte: FAQ: Monthly recurring income and the Tiquiz affiliate program

questions.question: How does the Tiquiz affiliate program work?
questions.reponse: You get a unique tracked link when you sign up. Every person who subscribes to a paid Tiquiz plan through your link is tied to you for life. You earn 40% recurring commission at the minimum on every payment from your referral, which turns into monthly recurring income paid between the 10th and the 13th of every month to your PayPal or bank account.

questions.question: How much can I build with the Tiquiz affiliate program?
questions.reponse: On the monthly plan at €17, you earn €5.67 per referral per month, or €68 per year per referral. On the annual plan at €170, you earn €56.67 per referral per year. With 30 active referrals on monthly, your income hits €170/mo. With 50 active referrals on annual, your income hits €2,833.33/yr. These figures use the 40% starting rate: your first paying referral moves you to 45%, and the rate climbs to 70%. A simulator on the Tiquiz affiliate page projects your income for the referral count you are aiming at.

questions.question: Do I need to be a Tiquiz customer to earn affiliate income?
questions.reponse: No, the program is open with no conditions. You can sign up and earn income even if you're not a Tiquiz customer yourself. That said, using the tool makes your recommendations more authentic and naturally boosts your conversion rate.

questions.question: When do I get paid for my Tiquiz affiliate income?
questions.reponse: Your income is paid between the 10th and the 13th of every month, via PayPal or bank transfer (your choice). A commission becomes payable 30 days after your referral pays, and the transfer goes out from €20 onwards. No invoice to send, no follow-up needed: we write the invoice for you. You set up your payment method once at signup, and your income lands every month on autopilot.

questions.question: Do my Tiquiz referrals stay tied to me for life?
questions.reponse: Yes. If someone clicks your link today, creates a free Tiquiz account, then upgrades to a paid plan in 7 days, 6 months or 2 years, the income is yours. As long as they stay subscribed, you keep earning your commission on every payment.

questions.question: What supports do I get to launch my affiliate income?
questions.reponse: You step into a dedicated Tiquiz affiliate dashboard on signup: centralized tracked links (one click to generate a link to any page), an image generator in Instagram/LinkedIn/X/stories/Pinterest formats, an editable post library for LinkedIn/Instagram/X/Threads, an editable email library (intro, demo, testimonial, follow-up), and real-time commission tracking. Tracking and payouts run through Systeme.io under the hood. Coming soon: audience-specific advice and per-channel promotion strategies.

blocs.texte: And now?

blocs.html:
You have everything you need to decide whether the Tiquiz affiliate program belongs in your stack of complementary income.



The bare minimum to start:



  1. Sign up at tiquiz.fr/affiliation (2 minutes)

  2. Grab your tracked link from your affiliate dashboard

  3. Slip your link into 2 or 3 pieces of content you already planned this month (newsletter, LinkedIn post, YouTube video)

  4. Watch your first referrals show up in your dashboard

  5. Get your first commission in the payout window that follows your first referral's first paid subscription, 30 days after they pay. From there, the commission becomes recurring and your income builds up month after month.



No need to build an elaborate affiliate funnel. The best strategy is the simplest: you talk about Tiquiz when it's natural, to people who can actually use it. The income stacks up as you bring in referrals, and your rate climbs with them.
